# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**My top pick is the JBL Charge 6.** It's IP68-rated, has 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and doubles as a power bank. What Hi-Fi named it best waterproof speaker overall, and Best Products picked it too. Prices in the reviews ran from $129.99 at Walmart to $149.95 at Amazon.
- [Buy links at What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- [Best Products review](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

## Other picks by need

- **Loudest for pool parties: JBL Boombox 4.** RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It floats, handles long immersion, and has 40+ hours of battery. It's big and expensive, and its sound is directional. [RTINGS review with buy links](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)
- **360° sound for a group: Ultimate Ears EPICBOOM.** IP67, floats, about 15 hours of battery. Tom's Guide ranks it best overall, and RTINGS calls it the best mid-range pick. [Tom's Guide](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)
- **Best budget: Ultimate Ears WONDERBOOM 4.** IP67, floats, 14 hours, about $65 in the Best Products listing. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)
- **Most portable: JBL Grip.** Good Housekeeping's best overall for the beach. It's IP68, can-sized, under a pound, and about $100, with 12 hours of battery. [Good Housekeeping](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **Cheapest: JBL Go 5.** IP67 and about $40, but only 8 hours of battery. [What Hi-Fi](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)
- **Big sound for the money: Soundcore Boom 2.** It floats and has strong bass, at about $110 in the Best Products listing. It has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach. [Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

## Soundcore deal

- [Soundcore Boom 3i Rugged Waterproof Speaker](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-3i): $129.99, or $104 with the code
- [Soundcore Boom 2 Plus](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-boom-2-plus): $249.99, or $200 with the code

These are affiliate links, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy. Neither model is covered in the reviews I found, so I can't vouch for their sound or durability.

## Beach and pool tips

- An IP67 or IP68 rating is the number to look for. Reviewers say IPX7 is the minimum, and IP6X also keeps sand out.
- IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage, according to RTINGS. Rinse the speaker with fresh water afterward if the manual allows it.
- Close the charging-port flap, and let the speaker dry fully before you charge it.

If you tell me your budget and whether you want it loud or pocketable, I can narrow this to one.
